summary: Boise NF ground lookout with an L-4 cab recorded in 1932, about 10 miles SW of Lowman; listed gone, one source says removed; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Sources describe it as abandoned and gone; Forest Lookouts says removed; no source gives a date for either

staffing.status: no documented staffing history (Idaho Fire Lookouts)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site drive-up; no current access rule found in the sources read

notes_for_editor: Separate from us-id-jackson-peak (standing 1927 cabin at 44.07793, -115.41386, about 30 km northeast); do not merge. Brief record matches the ground/gone listing row at 44.00975, -115.77652. No source gives a date for abandonment or removal, and no source describes the site today.
